overview: Rockport TX PD  uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Rockport TX PD  utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Rockport TX PD  utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
shares_data_with: Rockport TX PD is not sharing data with any partner networks.
external_agencies: Rockport TX PD is not sharing data with any partner networks.
acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Rockport TX PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Traffic enforcement, harrassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy:
Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
*Hotlist refers to alerts related to stolen vehicles, warrants or Amber Alerts.
